heading: Hi, we're Clear Sky
intro: We help CEOs, creators, marketing leads, and the creatives inside companies change how content gets made and how it feels to watch. Everything you need to succeed, done with intention and ownership.

story.text: It all started with Cameron. After college, with a Cinematic Arts degree and his Major League Baseball dreams retired, he mixed his two passions into a niche baseball account on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

photos.alt: Cameron as a kid on the beach
Cameron running the bases in a baseball game

story.text: Over the next two years he discovered a skill that most businesses suddenly needed in 2020: making content people actually stop for. So he started Clear Sky, with one simple mission. Help businesses grow their visibility on social media through quality content.

photos.alt: Cameron with a cinema camera rig
Cameron behind the camera giving a thumbs up

story.text: Each project was better than the last. The team grew, the services widened, and over five years Clear Sky went from a one-person social content company to a full-service creative agency.

photos.alt: A full crew setting up lights on a shoot

story.text: Then we noticed a trend. Social media is crowded with misleading ads, fake news, and a sales-at-all-costs mindset, and trust in brands is at an all-time low. We think social media needs a renaissance, and we want to help lead it.

photos.alt: Cameron with the Evolus team on a shoot
Filming an interview in a bright studio

mission: To build good brands with honest content. We want to lead the way back to trust-filled marketing, using ethical methods to promote your business.

values.title: Transparency
values.body: You see the plan, the process, and the numbers. No surprises.

values.title: Integrity
values.body: We only make promises we can keep, and we keep them.

values.title: Love
values.body: We care about the people behind the brand and the people watching.

values.title: Selflessness
values.body: Your win is the point. When you grow, we grow with you.
